drhp.business: The Company's core business is the manufacturing, distribution and marketing of Friction Materials in India and abroad, comprising Brake Lining, Clutch Facing, Disc Brake Pad, Roll Lining and Brake Block, serving automotive OEMs, the aftermarket and Indian Railways/wagon manufacturers. It also runs an investment segment that deploys funds in equity instruments, government securities, debentures, bonds and commodities, and, from 1st April 2025, a new trading-in-metals-and-commodities business line.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Flagged in MD&A 'Risks and Concerns' as a factor affecting the automotive/rail industries the Company serves, amid escalating tensions in West Asia disrupting global energy and logistics channels.
- MD&A flags commodity price volatility as a risk; the Company's financial-instrument note separately describes commodity risk on raw materials as managed through forward booking, inventory management and vendor development.
- MD&A lists currency volatility as a risk to the automotive sector and the Company's outlook.
- MD&A flags evolving emission and regulatory norms in the automotive industry as a risk factor.
- MD&A flags rising competitive intensity as a risk to the Company's market position.
- MD&A lists increasing logistics and energy costs among the Company's Risks and Concerns.
- The Company holds a major part of its investments in bonds, debentures, government securities and preference shares, which the financial-risk-management note identifies as exposed to market price risk from interest-rate movements, in turn affecting profitability and instrument values.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continued thrust on new product development to meet changed customer requirements, provide better customer service and upgrade technology.
- Improvement in quality, cost rationalisation, cash preservation and digitalisation.
- Aggressively pursue opportunities for new OEM approvals and improve market share in OE and aftermarket.
- Continue working with Indian railway and wagon manufacturers to develop superior friction material for their requirements, positioning the Company as both an automotive and rail mobility solutions provider.
